title: The Mathematics of Infinity
summary: Through convergent series, Hilbert's Hotel, and Cantor's infinities, Maran learns that endless possibility does not erase finite responsibility and that continuity can live through relations between bounded lives.

links.note: The problem of infinity narrows into the problem of proportion, repetition, and deviation.
Finite responsibility anticipates the Common Center's accountable relational world.
X later confronts computational infinity and centralization at universe scale.
